meta.bit_reading_note: every circuit has six classical bits. In the wait test (circuit W-no, W-ref; part W) c0 to c4 are the end lines' results (manacitra.wait.WAIT_TEST_ROUNDS) and c5 is M's; in the Ramsey circuits and the zero-wait baseline (part R) only M is measured, into c5 (the label's m_clbit), and the other bits read 0
meta.description: Kickoff 52, the phase sweep. Two waiting qubits M: 143 on 144-143-142, and 144 on 143-144-145. A known phase phi in {0, 60, 120, 180, 240, 300} degrees, one rz(phi) on M right after its first H. Per M and phi: W-no(phi), R0(phi) and R1(phi) as in Kickoff 51; per M at phi = 0: W-ref (XY4) and Z. 40 circuits, each 2 copies of 4000 shots (80 positions), in one random order; the sampler's own dynamical decoupling and twirling off, as IBM recorded them.
meta.bit_order: Qiskit bitstrings, rightmost character = classical bit 0

built_from.how: Kickoff 51's circuits and transformations, unchanged (hw_51.py and hw_50.py, byte-identical copies), at six phases; against the live ibm_fez target at build

T_M.definition: from the end of M's first H (its first sx) to the start of its last H (its last sx), in the wait test without refocusing (W-no) as scheduled by manacitra.wait.scheduled on the live target

fixed_before_the_data.rule: H52a on 143 and H52b on 144: DIFFERENT if Delta = theta_W - theta_R0, wrapped to (-180, +180], has its interval entirely outside [-margin_deg, +margin_deg]; SAME if entirely inside; NOT SETTLED otherwise. The thetas are fitted (fit); the fit is fixed here, before the data
fixed_before_the_data.bootstraps: 90% intervals (5th and 95th percentiles) from one joint bootstrap (seed bootstrap, n_boot draws), in a fixed order: M by M (143, then 144): F for W-no at the six phases and W-ref, then P(1) for Z and R0, R1 each at the six phases; refitting on every resample, each resampled angle difference wrapped to within 180 degrees of the point estimate; for each, the wait test's F (the copies with replacement, each redrawn from a multinomial), then M's P(1) (the copies with replacement, each redrawn binomially)
fixed_before_the_data.fit: y = c + b cos(phi) + s sin(phi), OLS over the six phases; R: theta = atan2(s, -b) on the loss; W: theta = atan2(-s, b) on F_no

hw_52.py.text:
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE / "site"))
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))
import manacitra  # noqa: E402
from manacitra import wait as W  # noqa: E402
import hw_51 as K51  # noqa: E402  Kickoff 51's transformations, unchanged
import analyse_52 as AN  # noqa: E402  the section 3 fit, for check 5

K50 = K51.K50
COMMIT, TAG_NAME = "a55354d0d4903d5d624c6cf946b8130d0ccc4b57", "v0.5.0"
K49_SHA = K50.K49_SHA
K51_CODE_SHA = {"hw_51.py": "e7e19a92b770d122bb8728c3f709c5e6f10214abb1243db455097215923b6146",
                "hw_50.py": "f6ed4e35ff8f03554586e81ddd06582f6d219f4a33b0c4dbe6773747b4e578ef"}   # hardware-51/inputs.json
CHAINS = {"143": [144, 143, 142], "144": [143, 144, 145]}
PHIS = (0, 60, 120, 180, 240, 300)
COPIES, SHOTS = 2, 4_000
SEEDS = {"order": 5252, "bootstrap": 52, "n_boot": 10_000}
M_CLBIT = W.WAIT_TEST_CLBITS - 1
T_M_K51 = 2611
CAL_K51 = "2026-10-13 17:32:21 UTC"


def sha(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


now = K50.now


def log(msg):
    line = f"{now()} {msg}"
    print(line, flush=True)
    with (HERE / "run.log").open("a") as f:
        f.write(line + "\n")


def cell_items():
    out = []
    for n in CHAINS:
        kinds = [(k, p) for k in ("W-no", "R0", "R1") for p in PHIS] + [("W-ref", 0), ("Z", 0)]
        out += [(n, k, p, cp) for k, p in kinds for cp in range(1, COPIES + 1)]
    return out


def build_chain(name, chain, backend):
    t, dt = backend.target, backend.dt
    M = chain[1]
    no = W.build_wait_test(chain, False, backend)
    ref = W.build_wait_test(chain, True, backend)
    no0_ins, _ = K50.schedule(no, backend, chain)
    tl0 = K50.timed(no0_ins, t, dt, chain)
    T = K50.window(tl0, M)["T_dt"]
    z_ins, z_isa = K51._made(K50.logical("Z", T), chain, backend)
    circ = {("W-ref", 0): ref, ("Z", 0): K50.rebuild(z_isa, z_ins, f"Z-{name}")}
    for phi in PHIS:
        wno = K50.rebuild(no, K51.insert_phase(K50.instructions(no), M, phi), f"W-no{phi:+d}-{name}")
        circ[("W-no", phi)] = wno
        w_ins, _ = K50.schedule(wno, backend, chain)
        circ[("R1", phi)] = K50.rebuild(no, K50.cz_to_delays(w_ins, M, t, dt), f"R1{phi:+d}-{name}")
        ins, isa = K51._made(K51.logical("R0", T, phi), chain, backend)
        circ[("R0", phi)] = K50.rebuild(isa, ins, f"R0{phi:+d}-{name}")
    return circ, {"T_M": K50.window(tl0, M), "tl_no": tl0}


def checks(name, chain, circ, info, backend):
    t, dt = backend.target, backend.dt
    L1, M, L3 = chain
    ideal = W.wait_test_ideal()
    T = info["T_M"]["T_dt"]
    rec, tls, exact = {}, {}, {"W": {}, "R0": {}, "R1": {}}
    for (k, phi), c in circ.items():
        key = f"{k}|{phi}"
        ins, _ = K50.schedule(c, backend, chain)
        tl = K50.timed(ins, t, dt, chain)
        tls[(k, phi)] = tl
        ops = {a: int(b) for a, b in c.count_ops().items()}
        init = list(c.layout.initial_index_layout(filter_ancillas=True))
        p = W.exact_distribution(c)
        r = {"count_ops": ops, "no_swap": ops.get("swap", 0) == 0, "layout_as_named": init == chain,
             "non_delay_ops_only_on_chain": {c.find_bit(q).index for i in c.data if i.operation.name != "delay" for q in i.qubits} <= set(chain)}
        seq = K51.m_sequence(c, M)
        if k.startswith("W"):
            r["exact_F"] = W.fidelity(p, ideal)
            r["exact_F_expected"] = math.cos(math.radians(phi) / 2) ** 2
            r["exact_F_as_expected"] = abs(r["exact_F"] - r["exact_F_expected"]) < 1e-6
            r["structure_5cz_6meas_3reset"] = ops.get("cz") == 5 and ops.get("measure") == 6 and ops.get("reset") == 3
            if k == "W-no":
                exact["W"][phi] = r["exact_F"]
        else:
            r["exact_P1_M"] = sum(v for kk, v in p.items() if kk[0] == "1")
            r["exact_P1_expected"] = math.sin(math.radians(phi) / 2) ** 2
            r["exact_P1_as_expected"] = abs(r["exact_P1_M"] - r["exact_P1_expected"]) < 1e-9
            w = K50.window(tl, M)
            r["M_window"] = w
            r["window_ok"] = (w["T_dt"] == T if k != "Z" else w["T_dt"] == 0) and w["n_sx"] == 2
            if k in ("R0", "R1"):
                exact[k][phi] = r["exact_P1_M"]
        if k in ("W-no", "R0", "R1"):
            i = [n for n, _ in seq].index("sx")
            r["M_first_H_then_phase"] = seq[i - 1:i + 3]
            r["phase_right_after_first_H"] = seq[i - 1] == ("rz", 90.0) and seq[i + 1] == ("rz", 90.0) and seq[i + 2] == ("rz", float(phi))
            rz_t = [s for _, nm, qs, _, s, d in tl if nm == "rz" and qs == [M]]
            w = K50.window(tl, M)
            r["phase_time_dt"] = rz_t[2]
            r["phase_inside_window"] = w["start_dt"] <= rz_t[2] <= w["end_dt"]
            r["one_rz_per_place"] = [n for n, _ in seq].count("rz") == 5
        if k == "W-no":
            j0 = [n for n, _ in seq].index("sx")
            j1 = len(seq) - 1 - [n for n, _ in seq][::-1].index("sx")
            between = seq[j0 + 1:j1]
            inner = between[2:-1]
            r["M_ops_between_H"] = [n for n, _ in between]
            r["check3_cz_barrier_and_phase_only"] = {n for n, _ in inner} <= {"cz", "barrier"} and [n for n, _ in inner].count("cz") == 5
        if k == "W-ref":
            r["pulses_on_M"] = K50.x_on(c, M) > K50.x_on(circ[("W-no", 0)], M)
        rec[key] = r
    tab = {str(q): {"W-no unedited": K50.events(info["tl_no"], q), **{f"{k}|{phi}": K50.events(tls[(k, phi)], q) for k in ("W-no", "R1") for phi in PHIS}} for q in (L1, L3)}
    same = all(v == tab[str(q)]["W-no unedited"] for q in (L1, L3) for v in tab[str(q)].values())
    rec["_neighbours"] = {"measure_reset_times": tab, "R1_and_W_no_same_as_W_no_unedited": same}
    # check 5: the section 3 fit on the exact values gives theta 0 in all three instruments and Delta 0
    tW = float(AN.theta_W([exact["W"][p] for p in PHIS]))
    tR0 = float(AN.theta_R([exact["R0"][p] for p in PHIS]))
    tR1 = float(AN.theta_R([exact["R1"][p] for p in PHIS]))
    rec["_check5_fit_on_exact"] = {"theta_W": tW, "theta_R0": tR0, "theta_R1": tR1, "Delta": float(AN.wrap(tW - tR0)),
                                   "pass": max(abs(tW), abs(tR0), abs(tR1)) < 1e-6}
    flat = [v for kk, r in rec.items() if not kk.startswith("_") for v in r.values() if isinstance(v, bool)]
    return rec, all(flat) and same and rec["_check5_fit_on_exact"]["pass"]


def build(backend):
    circ, recs, infos, ok = {}, {}, {}, True
    for name, chain in CHAINS.items():
        c, info = build_chain(name, chain, backend)
        r, good = checks(name, chain, c, info, backend)
        ok = ok and good
        circ[name], recs[name], infos[name] = c, r, {"T_M": info["T_M"]}
    return circ, recs, infos, ok


def assemble(circ, seed=SEEDS["order"]):
    items = cell_items()
    perm = np.random.default_rng(seed).permutation(len(items))
    circs, labels = [], []
    for i in perm:
        n, k, phi, cp = items[i]
        circs.append(circ[n][(k, phi)])
        labels.append({"M": int(n), "chain": CHAINS[n], "circuit": k, "phi_deg": phi, "copy": cp, "m_clbit": M_CLBIT,
                       "part": "W" if k.startswith("W") else "R"})
    return circs, labels, [SHOTS] * len(circs)
